title: Conditions on the Credit Standing on a Plan Being Set Against Quoted Upgrade Labor
content:
# Conditions on the Credit Standing on a Plan Being Set Against Quoted Upgrade Labor

**Condition 1.** Where the balance of the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans carries a credit and the payments received in the twelve months to the handling day are at least the charges raised in them, half the credit standing on the plan — 50 per cent of it — is set against the quoted labor.

**Condition 2.** Where the plan's balance carries a credit and the payments received in the twelve months to the handling day are less than the charges raised in them, a quarter of the credit standing on the plan, that is 25 per cent of it, is set against the quoted labor.

**Condition 3.** In every other case none of the credit standing on the plan is set against the quoted labor.

**Condition 4.** The amount so set against the labor is taken to two decimal places.

| Plan's balance carries a credit | Payments received in the twelve months, against the charges raised in them | Set against the quoted labor |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least the charges raised | half the credit standing on the plan |
| yes | less than the charges raised | a quarter of the credit standing on the plan |
| no | either | none of it |

## Points of judgement

- Payments exactly equal to the charges raised in the twelve months fall under Condition 1, the boundary being at least the charges raised.
- The charges counted are those that fell due on the plan in the twelve months to the handling day; the payments counted are those received in that window.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A plan carrying 800 USD of credit standing on it, with 6200 USD of payments received against 5900 USD of charges in the twelve months, has 400.00 USD set against the quoted labor. With 4800 USD of payments against those charges, 200.00 USD is set against it.
